text: I've now been waiting over an hour for someone to ring me back so I'll put it all in here. My granddaughter is 23 months old and she's had a temperature since yesterday, it was 38.3 when I took it just now. I've been giving her Calpol and ibuprofen at the right times, written it all down, and in between the doses she's absolutely fine, playing with her blocks, drinking her milk and water no problem, chattering away to me and the dog. Then it creeps back up before the next dose is due. My son says it's normal for kids but I've been told different things by different people and I'd just like someone who knows to say whether this is alright to manage at home or whether she needs to see a doctor. I don't think that's too much to ask at this point.
